purpose: Interactive guided workflow to help users complete RECA Downwinder Claim Form

questions.question: Who is filing this claim?

options.label: I became ill with a compensable disease
I am the surviving spouse of someone who became ill
I am the surviving child of someone who became ill
I am the parent of someone who became ill
I am the grandchild of someone who became ill
I am the grandparent of someone who became ill

questions.help_text: This determines which sections of the form you need to complete.

questions.question: Have you been diagnosed with one of the compensable cancers listed by RECA?
Is the person who became ill deceased?
questions.validation: Must be YES to be eligible as surviving spouse

questions.question: Were you married to the person who became ill for at least one year immediately before their death?
questions.validation: Must be YES to be eligible as surviving spouse

questions.question: Is the person who became ill deceased?
questions.validation: Must be YES to be eligible as surviving child

questions.question: Was the person who became ill physically present in a designated affected area during the required time periods?

options.label: In a designated affected area for at least 1 year between Jan 21, 1951 - Nov 6, 1962
In a designated affected area for the entire period Jun 30, 1962 - Jul 31, 1962
In the State of New Mexico for at least 1 year between Sep 24, 1944 - Nov 6, 1962
I'm not sure / Need to see the list of areas

questions.help_text: At least ONE of these must be true to be eligible.

eligible.message: Based on your answers, you appear to be eligible to file a RECA Downwinder claim. Let's proceed with completing the form.

ineligible_spouse_not_deceased.message: Unfortunately, to file as a surviving spouse, the person who became ill must be deceased. You are not eligible to file this claim at this time.

ineligible_spouse_one_year.message: Unfortunately, to file as a surviving spouse, you must have been married to the person who became ill for at least one year immediately before their death. You are not eligible to file under this relationship category.

ineligible_child_not_deceased.message: Unfortunately, to file as a surviving child, the person who became ill must be deceased. You are not eligible to file this claim at this time.

ineligible_no_exposure.message: Unfortunately, to be eligible for RECA Downwinder compensation, the person who became ill must have been physically present in a designated affected area during the required time periods. Based on your answers, you may not be eligible.
ineligible_no_exposure.note: Consider reviewing the affected areas list carefully or contacting RECA at 1-800-729-7327

question_1.question: Does 'Continue Claim' workflow already exist?
question_1.implications: If yes, need to understand overlap with new guided workflow
required_info: What happens when user clicks 'Continue Claim'?
Is there existing form filling functionality?
How is current claim data stored?

question_2.question: Should guided workflow directly modify claim records or only assist with form generation?

option_a.description: Workflow saves directly to claim record as user progresses
option_a.pros: Single source of truth, no data sync issues

option_b.description: Workflow maintains its own state, generates forms/data at the end
option_b.pros: Decoupled, can work offline, easier to update
option_b.cons: Need sync mechanism, potential data duplication

question_2.recommendation: Option A (Direct modification) for seamless user experience and data integrity

question_3.question: What file upload mechanism exists for documents?
required_info: Current document storage solution (S3, database, etc.)?

question_4.question: Is electronic submission to RECA.gov API-enabled or manual upload?

implications.if_manual: Generate PDF for user to upload to RECA portal

question_5.question: Should we create a completely new UI workflow or integrate into existing claim flow?

options.new_modal_flow: Open assistant in modal/overlay, separate from main claim editing
options.integrated_inline: Replace existing claim form with guided sections
options.hybrid: Guided mode as option, traditional form still available

question_5.recommendation: Hybrid approach - guided mode as default/recommended, direct form editing still available

frontend.framework: Based on existing RadiantClaims stack (likely React/Next.js)

backend.data_storage: Extend existing claim table schema or create related workflow_progress table
api_endpoints_needed: GET /api/workflow/disease-requirements/{diseaseId} - Get disease-specific medical record requirements
backend.document_handling: Integrate with existing document upload system

requirements: Map JSON form data to PDF field names
Generate multi-page documents with proper formatting
